board: SparkFun Weather Meter Kit SEN-15901 wind vane (RJ11 cable, vane on outer conductors pins 1 and 4)
reason: Modelled as the datasheet's real circuit: 8 reed-switch controls (1 = closed), each switching its own resistor (33k/8.2k/1k/2.2k/3.9k/16k/120k/64.9k) in parallel from WDIR to GND, with a 10 kOhm pull-up to 3.3 V; the driver maps the divider resistance to the nearest of the 16 datasheet table values. The check passed on ESP32 and Pico for NE (single switch) and ESE (E+SE in parallel = 688 ohm).
breakoutPinoutSource: Weather Meter datasheet DS-15901 wiring diagram and text (anemometer on RJ11 inner pins 2 and 3, vane on the outer pair) plus the SparkFun Weather Meter Hookup Guide
